newsitem.title: USA: St. Jude Medical launches CoaguChek in U.S..
newsitem.headline: St. Jude Medical launches CoaguChek in U.S..

text.p: St. Jude Medical Inc said Thursday it has launched the CoaguChek System in the U.S. market.
CoaguChek is a self-test for measuring blood coagulation levels. St. Jude is providing the product through an exclusive alliance with Boehringer Mannheim Corp of Germany.
St. Jude said more than 35 U.S. cardiac surgery centers are currently involved in a training program for teaching patients to use the system.
Patients receiving mechanical heart valve implantations must use anticoagulants, and St. Jude said many post-operative complications result from limitations in managing anticoagulation therapy.
St. Jude develops, manufactures and distributes medical services for the global cardiovascular market.
